race.line.looseTurn: On loose ground, turn the car on the way in - a lift or a dab of the left-foot brake as you turn in, the handbrake in a hairpin - so it points at the exit before the apex and the power goes down early; more angle than that only scrubs speed.
race.line.fwdLoose: Front-driven: add power only as the wheel unwinds, or the front washes wide.
race.line.fwd: Front-driven: rotate it on the brakes before the apex and add power only as the wheel unwinds, or the front washes wide.
race.line.rwdPower: Rear-driven with this much power: straighten it before full throttle, or the rear steps out.
race.line.awd: All-wheel drive: it can take power while still turning, so pick the throttle up early.
race.line.afterStraight: At the end of a straight the braking zone is the prize: brake as late as the car allows and apex where the corner lets you{power, select, yes { - braking in a straight line and turning late keeps the braking straight and short} other {}}.
race.line.bothMomentum: Between two straights{ratio, select, none {} other { ({ratio} of its grip as acceleration here)}}: brake late, but keep the line round and the minimum speed up - this car cannot win back what it scrubs.
race.line.bothPower: Between two straights{ratio, select, none {} other { ({ratio} of its grip as acceleration here)}}: both ends pay. A V does both - brake late in a straight line, rotate the car in a short, tight middle, and be straight and flat early.
race.line.link: A corner between corners: drive it for the exit of the next one that leads onto a straight, even at a cost here.
race.line.fastAero: A fast corner at {speed} km/h in a car with downforce{ratio, select, none {} other { ({ratio} of its grip as acceleration here)}}: a wide, round line with a slightly late apex keeps the minimum speed up - it cannot win back speed it scrubs.
race.line.momentum: A car that accelerates weakly for its grip{ratio, select, none {} other { ({ratio} of its grip as acceleration here)}}: a wide, round line with a slightly late apex keeps the minimum speed up - it cannot win back speed it scrubs.
race.line.power: A car that accelerates hard for its grip{ratio, select, none {} other { ({ratio} of its grip as acceleration here)}}: brake in a straight line, turn in late, rotate it in a short, tight middle and have it straight early - full throttle is worth more than the minimum speed.
race.line.ontoStraight: Onto a straight{ratio, select, none {} other { ({ratio} of its grip as acceleration here)}}: slow in, fast out - a late apex that opens the exit, so full throttle comes early and lasts the whole straight.

race.event.lock.tipFront: A locked front cannot steer: the car runs wide. Less pressure at the top of the braking zone, then bleed it off as you turn in.
race.event.lock.tipRear: A locked rear lets the car rotate or step out: braking while turned, or a downshift before the revs allow, unloads it. Brake a touch more in a straight line and ease off as you turn in; if it keeps happening, move the brake bias forwards.
race.event.lock.tipLoose: On loose ground a locked wheel ploughs on: squeeze the brake to just short of locking and keep the wheels turning.
race.event.lock.tip: Too much pedal for the grip: a locked tyre stops worse than one at the edge of grip. Squeeze harder more progressively and ease off when the car starts to slide.

race.event.wheelspin.tipLoose: Feed the throttle in; on loose ground a higher gear softens the torque - wheelspin digs, it does not drive.
race.event.wheelspin.tip: Feed the throttle in as the steering unwinds, and short-shift where the car is traction-limited: spinning tyres drive the car nowhere.

race.event.understeer.slip: At {from}-{to} m, from {speed} km/h: the front tyres ran {peak} of their nominal peak slip angle, past {limit} where this car's front grip falls away, while the rear held ({them}: {theirs}).
race.event.understeer.tip: More lock does nothing once the front has gone: arrive a little slower, keep a trace of brake into the turn to load the front, and unwind rather than add steering.
race.event.understeer.tipLoose: On loose ground, turn the car before the front can push: a lift or a dab of the left-foot brake as you turn in brings the rear round.

race.event.hit.tipRear: Struck from behind - another car, or the car sliding backwards into something.
race.event.hit.tipCrash: Into something head-on: the corner came faster than the car could turn or stop - brake earlier here, the time a crash costs is far more than any braking point gains.
race.event.hit.tipFront: A knock at the front: clipped something - a car, a barrier, a kerb's edge.

race.cause.nearStopTip: Down to {mine} km/h at {at} m where {them} kept {theirs} km/h: a spin, contact or a missed corner, not a question of technique. Replay it to see which.

race.cause.liftedTip: {me} came off the throttle at {at} m and was {diff} km/h slower through it; {them} {flat, select, yes {kept its foot down} other {lifted at {theirsAt} m}}. Lift less, or later - a lift here is paid for all the way down the straight after.

race.cause.brakedForLiftTip: {me} braked at {at} m down to {mine} km/h; {them} {flat, select, yes {kept its foot down} other {only lifted}} and held {theirs} km/h. A lift, or a lighter brush of the brake, is enough here.
race.cause.brakedGentlyTyres: The tyres never came near where this car's brakes give their best: brake harder at the start of the zone, then bleed it off as you turn in.
race.cause.brakedGentlyTip: {peak} m/s² against the {own} {me} managed elsewhere at this speed: brake harder at the start of the zone, then bleed it off as you turn in.
race.cause.carBrakesTip: Not a driving fault: {me} stops at {own} m/s² from {speed} km/h, {them} at {theirs}. Keep braking in a straight line at the limit.
race.cause.brakedEarlyTipCar: Brake later - about {metres} m: at the {decel} m/s² {me} brakes with elsewhere, {from} km/h to {to} km/h takes {needed} m, it used {used} - and keep the same turn-in and throttle point.
race.cause.brakedEarlyTip: Brake later - about {metres} m - and keep the same turn-in and throttle point.
race.cause.coastedTip: Neither pedal down for {mine} m ({them}: {theirs} m). Brake later or pick the throttle up sooner - a coasting car loses speed for nothing.
race.cause.tightLine: {me} {diff} km/h slower through the middle, on a tighter radius
race.cause.tightLineTip: Slowest on a {rMine} m radius against {rTheirs} m for {them}: the radius alone explains {share}% of the {diff} km/h, since the speed a radius allows grows with its square root. Use more of the road - turn in from wider and a touch earlier, so the arc through the middle opens up.
race.cause.carGripTip: Not a driving fault: {me} was at its limit ({slid, select, yes {{drift} of drift} other {{lat} m/s² sideways}}; it holds about {own} at {speed} km/h for half a second), and {them}'s car holds {theirs}. Braking later will not close that. Protect the exit instead - brake in a straight line, turn in later and straighten the car sooner.
race.cause.sideways: {me} {diff} km/h slower through the middle - sideways
race.cause.sidewaysTip: {me} ran {drift} of drift into the middle{theirs, select, none {} other { ({them}: {theirs})}}: past its grip, not short of it - a car going sideways scrubs speed and has to be caught. Arrive a little slower and turn in more gently, so the car takes the corner on its tyres; the speed comes back through the middle.
race.cause.sidewaysLoose: This car loses its rear more easily than {them}'s ({mine} catches a lap against {theirs}): give it a margin {them}'s does not need.
race.cause.carGripProfileTip: Not a driving fault: {me} holds {mine} m/s² sideways for half a second, {them} {theirs}. On {them}'s line that allows about {can} km/h where {them} carried {carried} km/h, and {me} carried {own} km/h. Braking later will not close that.
race.cause.spareLetsGo: But this car's rear has let go from about {from} m/s² ({slides} catches a lap): find the rest in small steps - a little more speed each lap, the brake released smoothly.
race.cause.spareTip: {mine} m/s² sideways at the slowest point against {theirs} for {them}, on a similar radius{limit, select, none {} other {; {me} holds about {limit} at this speed for half a second}}: the car has grip to spare - carry more speed to the apex and let the brake off sooner.
race.cause.slowerArrivalFlight: {mine} km/h into the braking zone against {theirs} km/h: that is decided before it - by the longer flight at {at} m after {corner}, which landed it slower.
race.cause.slowerArrivalTip: {mine} km/h into the braking zone against {theirs} km/h: that is decided before it - by the exit of the corner before and the car's pull.
race.cause.slowerToApexTip: Release the brake more smoothly and let the car roll more speed into the middle.
race.cause.rotationLess: {me} turned the car less on the way in
race.cause.rotationLessTip: {them} had the car turned into it - {theirs} of drift by its slowest point against {mine} for {me} - and was {what, select, power {on the power} other {flat}} {later} m sooner. On loose ground the car is turned on the way in rather than steered round: a lift or a dab of the left-foot brake as you turn in puts the weight on the front and lets the rear come round{how, select, handbrake { - {them} pulled the handbrake at {at} m to do it} tight {; in a corner this tight the handbrake does it too} other {}}. Then the car points at the exit before the apex, and the power can go down early.
race.cause.rotationMore: {me} turned the car too far on the way in
race.cause.rotationMoreTip: {mine} of drift by its slowest point against {theirs} for {them}, and {what, select, power {on the power} other {flat}} {later} m later: the car had to be straightened before the power could go down, and a car that sideways scrubs speed. Turn it in less hard - less flick, a shorter dab of the brake{handbrake, select, yes {, less handbrake} other {}} - just enough to point it at the exit.
race.cause.jumpTip: In the air from {from} m to {to} m, {longer} s longer than {them}, and {s} s lost by 40 m after landing: in the air the car cannot turn, brake or drive, and a long flight lands hard. Take the crest a little slower or with a dab of the brake before it, so the car stays low - but keep the throttle on at take-off, since lifting drops the nose.{before, select, yes { The corner comes straight after the landing: land already pointing where the road goes.} other {}}
race.cause.scrub: {me} lost {mine} km/h with the throttle down
race.cause.scrubContactTip: From {from} m to {to} m {me} lost {mine} km/h at full throttle ({them}: {theirs} km/h) - more like contact or a spin than a slide. Replay it to see which.
race.cause.scrubTip: From {from} m to {to} m {me} slowed while at full throttle ({them}: {theirs} km/h): the car was sliding, on a kerb, or turning tighter than its speed allowed. Arrive a touch slower, or on a wider line, so it can accelerate there instead.
race.cause.latePowerTip: Get on the power earlier - at {at} m, where {them} did. The exit speed is paid for all the way to {next}.
race.cause.hesitantTip: {lifts, plural, one {# lift} other {# lifts}} after picking up the throttle: one smooth squeeze to full, each lift throws drive away.
race.cause.wide: {me} ran {metres} m wide and waited for full throttle
race.cause.wideTip: From its slowest point to full throttle {me} took {metres} m longer than {them}: the car was still turning. Rotate it earlier - turn in a touch later and deeper, so it points down the straight sooner.
race.cause.lateFullTip: Squeeze to full throttle sooner, opening the steering as you do{acc, select, none {} other { - {me} accelerates at {acc} m/s² there}}.
race.cause.carDriveTip: Not a driving fault: {me} accelerates at {mine} m/s² at {speed} km/h, {them} at {theirs}. A later apex that straightens the exit gets the most out of it.
race.cause.slowerExitTip: A later apex, so the car is straight sooner and the power goes down earlier.
race.also.scrub: Also: {me} lost {lost} km/h with the throttle down at {from}-{to} m (about {s} s) - {contact, select, yes {more like contact or a spin than a slide} other {a slide, a kerb or a line too tight for the speed}}.
race.also.lift: Also: a lift on the straight at {at} m (about {s} s).
race.carNote.middleLeft: {them} carried {carried} km/h through the middle. With {less}% less grip, {me} could carry about {can} km/h on the same line: {car} km/h of the gap is the car, the other {left} km/h is there to be had.
race.carNote.middleCar: {them} carried {carried} km/h through the middle. With {less}% less grip, about {can} km/h is all {me} can carry on the same line, and it carried {own} km/h: that gap is the car, and braking earlier or later does not change it.
race.carNote.winAfter: Win it back after the apex: brake in a straight line, turn in a touch later and get the car pointed at the exit early, so the power goes down sooner{pull, select, yes { - where {me}'s stronger pull counts} other {}}.
race.carNote.loseLittle: Lose as little of it as possible: brake at the limit in a straight line and use all the road, a wide, round line - a bigger radius is the only way to more speed without more grip.
race.carNote.rear: {me}'s car loses its rear more easily than {them}'s - {mine} catches a lap against {theirs} - and here it did.
race.carNote.rearPower: Feed the throttle in only as the wheel unwinds, and short-shift out of the slow part.
